1: // Simple Canvas Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game" expected in HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Game state
11:   const player = { x: 20, y: 20, size: 20, speed: 2 };
12:   const barriers = [];
13:   const tokens = [];
14:   let lastTokenTime = 0;
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;
17:   const keys = {};
18: 
19:   // Utility
20:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) =>
21:     a.x < b.x + b.size && a.x + a.size > b.x &&
22:     a.y < b.y + b.size && a.y + a.size > b.y;
23: 
24:   // Input handling
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
27: 
28:   // Create moving barriers (simple back‑and‑forth)
29:   const createBarriers = () => {
30:     for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
31:       const horiz = i % 2 === 0; // alternating orientation
32:       const barrier = {
33:         x: horiz ? Math.random() * (width - 100) : Math.random() * width,
34:         y: horiz ? Math.random() * height : Math.random() * (height - 100),
35:         w: horiz ? 100 : 20,
36:         h: horiz ? 20 : 100,
37:         dx: horiz ? (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 1 : 0,
38:         dy: horiz ? 0 : (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 1,
39:         size: 0 // unused; keep API same as player/token
40:       };
41:       barriers.push(barrier);
42:     }
43:   };
44: 
45:   // Spawn a token at a random location
46:   const spawnToken = () => {
47:     const token = {
48:       x: Math.random() * (width - 20),
49:       y: Math.random() * (height - 20),
50:       size: 20,
51:       glow: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5 // for visual effect
52:     };
53:     tokens.push(token);
54:   };
55: 
56:   // Update loop
57:   const update = dt => {
58:     if (gameOver) return;
59:     // Move player
60:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.y -= player.speed;
61:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.y += player.speed;
62:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
63:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
64:     // Clamp
65:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.size, player.x));
66:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - player.size, player.y));
67: 
68:     // Move barriers
69:     barriers.forEach(b => {
70:       b.x += b.dx;
71:       b.y += b.dy;
72:       if (b.x < 0 || b.x + b.w > width) b.dx *= -1;
73:       if (b.y < 0 || b.y + b.h > height) b.dy *= -1;
74:     });
75: 
76:     // Collision detection player vs barriers
77:     for (const b of barriers) {
78:       const rect = { x: b.x, y: b.y, size: 0, w: b.w, h: b.h };
79:       // simple AABB check
80:       if (
81:         player.x < b.x + b.w && player.x + player.size > b.x &&
82:         player.y < b.y + b.h && player.y + player.size > b.y
83:       ) {
84:         gameOver = true;
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // Token collection
89:     for (let i = tokens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       if (rectIntersect(player, tokens[i])) {
91:         tokens.splice(i, 1);
92:         score++;
93:       }
94:     }
95: 
96:     // Spawn token every 3 seconds
97:     if (Date.now() - lastTokenTime > 3000) {
98:       spawnToken();
99:       lastTokenTime = Date.now();
100:     }
101:   };
102: 
103:   // Render loop
104:   const render = () => {
105:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
106:     // Player
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
108:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
109:     // Barriers
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
111:     barriers.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h));
112:     // Tokens
113:     tokens.forEach(t => {
114:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${t.glow})`;
115:       ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.size, t.size);
116:     });
117:     // UI
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
119:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
120:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
121:     if (gameOver) {
122:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
123:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
124:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
126:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
127:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
128:     }
129:   };
130: 
131:   // Main loop using requestAnimationFrame
132:   let last = performance.now();
133:   const loop = now => {
134:     const dt = now - last;
135:     last = now;
136:     update(dt);
137:     render();
138:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139:   };
140: 
141:   createBarriers();
142:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
143: })();

(End of file - total 143 lines)
</content>
